text:
nina.sales: Quick question from Greenline: they want a documented BYO-HSM cutover that supports automated monthly rotations, proof of non-exportability, and permission to run a scoped pen-test during the POC. Can ops/security confirm constraints?

raj.engineering: We support BYO-HSM via an HSM-proxy per tenant. Rotation can be API-driven with staged key overlap (suggest 10m). First unwrap after rotation may add ~10-30ms on cache miss.

tess.security: We can provide attestation certs and signed rotation records. "No-export" guarantee: we can supply HSM vendor policy + attestation snapshot proving key material is marked non-exportable. Pen-test allowed only against staging/proxy and control-plane with signed pentest form.

mike.sre: Cutover ops: recommend dry-run in staging, then production with a 45m window: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with 5m stabilization. Have rollback command ready (switch mapping back to old KEK). Need customer to whitelist our proxy IPs ahead of time.

olivia.solutions: Pricing note: BYO-HSM POC surcharge ~+20% due to ops and attestation packaging. If they want Redwood staff for ceremony (onsite or remote) that's a PS line item. I'll add an acceptance criterion: successful staged rotation in staging.

nina.sales: Please drop a short two-line answer for the security questionnaire Q12 (multi-custodian ceremonies) we can paste into the form.

tess.security: Two-line reply: "Redwood does not offer built-in multi-custodian HSM workflows in the hosted product. We provide a documented key ceremony script, attestation artifacts, and can run the ceremony jointly with customer ops; for a fully automated split-custody implementation we offer professional services."

raj.engineering: Quick ops snippet to test connectivity: 
```bash
curl -v --cert client.crt --key client.key \
  https://hsm-proxy.greenline-staging.redwood.ai/health \
  --cacert /path/to/attestation_root.pem
```
Expected: {"status":"ok","attestation_nonce":"<nonce>"}

mike.sre: I'll own the runbook and scheduling. Need the customer's TPS and % unwrap ops to size the proxy for the POC.

olivia.solutions: I'll prepare the SOW addendum and attach the pricing delta. Link will be added to the deal.

redwood-bot: Uploaded: GREENLINE_BYOHSM_Attestation_Pack.zip

nina.sales: Thanks team — I'll send this to the customer and request their TPS numbers and pentest scope. Ping here if anything changes.
